newsitem.title: UK: EMI shares fall on charge, outlook.
newsitem.headline: EMI shares fall on charge, outlook.

text.p: Shares in Britain's EMI Group Plc fell 15p to 1206, despressed by a restructuring charge and the impact of sterling's strength on the firm's full-year results, dealers said.
But news of company plans to return cash to shareholders limited the shares' downward potential, they added.
EMI earlier reported full-year, pre-tax profits before execptional items rose to 380.5 million stg from 367.3 million.
The results met most analysts' expectations.
The company said it would restructure its North American music operations and take a 117.2 million stg charge.
EMI said the current strength of the pound would likely depress earnings by around 30 million stg in the current financial year.
Chairman Sir Colin Southgate told Reuters that EMI plans to return some 500 million stg in cash to its shareholders.
